notes.title: v1.10: Day night cycle
notes.content:
http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/night.jpg
http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/night2.jpg

Feature
Day Night Cycle:
Now there is day night cycle system, player can config it on the map selection menu.

Free building placement:
Except the resource center, other base buildings can be placed freely on the map.

Improved ground vehicle destroyed effect:
When the ground vehicles are destroyed, this camouflage will change into rust color, and the heavy vehicles may have a chance to burn for a while before explosion.

New Building
Firebase:
The dozer can build the firebase which can garrison at most 4 infantries, and it can call the helicopter to carry a missile turret or even howitzer on it.

notes.title: Update 1.03: Panhard, faster game pace and new icons
notes.content:
http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/capsule.png

New Unit:
Panhard: A scout vehicle with auto-cannon, a very good raid unit.
http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/panhard.png

Balance:
Reduce the HP of base guard tower and firebase from 2500 to 1500.
Reduce the damage of base guard tower from 15 to 12.
Slower the attack speed of base guard tower.
Reduce the building speed of main structures from 30 sec to 20 sec.
Reduce the HP of flak truck from 450 to 425
Reduce the cost of ATV from 700 to 600.
Reduce the cost of Hummv from 600 to 500.
Increase the damage of T-95 Black Eagle from 210 to 225.
Reduce the Rapid Repair cool down time from 150 sec to 120 sec.

Bug fix:
Fix the bug that the base guard tower can be cancelled and return funds.
Fix the bug that when vehicles are attacking a building while on attack moving, it can not switch attack target by manual order.

Feature:
New capsule and icon for the game.
More help text and icons on building platform, mercenary camps and flag points.

notes.title: Hotfix Version 1.01
notes.content:
After receiving feedbacks from players, I made a hotfix version.

Fix:
1. Improve the ground vehicle pathfinding.
2. Fix some bugs that infantry can not garrison into some neutral buildings.
3. Debuff  the gurad tower, -25% damage, -20% attack range, -20% F-35 airsupport damage.
4. Increase the damage of Su-25 Strike from 350 to 400.

Thanks to all players, making RTS games is much harder than I expected, but I will keep polishing the game:)

http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/ArmorClash_2016-06-19_19-06-19-38.png

notes.title: Hotkey tips.
notes.content:
http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/auto_get_in.png


F + left click: Attack move to target point, units will automatically engaging.
R: Stop moving.
C: Reverse back, vehicle will reverse back for a short distance without turning, an useful micro to protect low hp units.
Z: When selecting infantries, they will automatically enter APCs nearby, no need to deliver them one by one. When selecting APC, they will order infantries nearby to board the vehicle.
G: When selecting infantries, they will automatically garrison into buildings nearby, no need to deliver them one by one.
X: Let the infantry move out from vehicles or buildings.

notes.title: Beta 0.81 is available
notes.content:
http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/392171335673424569/FDDF8C4F9E7B14D26E0BC168CA0921E503041C96/

http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/392171335673427177/8B3035780E0553F5A5BBFF9331432E0E776D2771/


Beta 0.81
New Units:
[olist]
BM-21: a low price MLRS unit, fire 10 rockets but with low accuracy.
BTR-90: a medium price APC with rapid cannon.

[/olist]

Features:
[olist]
Repairing: resource center at base and captured resource point can repair units nearby.
SU-25 strike: a level 3 command ability, calling a SU-25 to attack target point after a medium time, more efficient to garrisoned building.
Rifle Grenade: a level 2 command ability, infantries can use rifle grenade when attacking ground units, with a cooldown time of 8 sec.
Add Bloom effect.
Camera maximum height raised.
Optimize the map loading.
[/olist]
 
Balance:
[olist]
Resource center, barracks, factory building time reduced from 40 sec to 25 sec, Power plant, Command center building time reduced from 40 sec to 30 sec.
Cannon attack range of main battle tank reduced from 65 to 60.
Unit normal sight range reduced from 135 to 100.
The guard range of mercenaries reduced from 90 to 80.
[/olist]

Bug Fix:
[olist]
Fix infantry can move when playing dead animation.
Fix infantry attack type from cannon to machinegun.
[/olist]
